title: onClickCapture: catch clicks on the way down

slides.say: Want to log every click for analytics, even clicks whose propagation was stopped? Use a capture event.

slides.code: log()}>
slides.say: Add Capture to the end of the event name. This handler runs first, even though both buttons stop propagation.
Every event goes through three phases.

steps.say: First it travels down the tree, calling every on click capture handler.
Then the clicked element runs its own onClick.
Finally it travels back up, calling parent onClick handlers, unless propagation was stopped.

slides.text: Great for routers and analytics. Rare in app code.
slides.say: Capture events are useful for routers or analytics. You probably will not need them in app code.
